_README: Board cells classified by whether their PROPOSER transmitted the three null exemplar images, for the null-exemplar leak sensitivity analysis of 2026-09-13. `exposed` true means the cell's proposer sent example IMAGES including at least one null-category exemplar; false means it is a text control that sent the labels only. Verifier stages carry no null exemplar, so a cell whose label names an image VERIFIER over a text proposer is a text control.
